root_cause.text: In the tw9906_probe() function, when the call to write_regs() fails, the error path returns directly without freeing the v4l2_ctrl_handler that was previously allocated via v4l2_ctrl_handler_init() and v4l2_ctrl_new_std(), causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a call to v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl) in the error handling block after the failed write_regs() call, as shown in the diff: `if (write_regs(sd, initial_registers) < 0) { v4l2_err(...); + v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl); return -EINVAL; }`. The CVE and commit message explicitly state that the allocated memory was not freed in that error path.
